Container.Name: bravia-remote
Container.Overview: Phone-friendly web remote for older (non-Android) Sony BRAVIA TVs. D-pad, volume, inputs, power (wake-on-LAN), media keys. Uses host networking so wake-on-LAN broadcasts reach the TV. Open the WebUI on your phone and add it to your home screen.

Config.Name: TV IP address
Config.Description: IP address of the TV. Give it a DHCP reservation in your router so it doesn't change.

Config.Name: TV MAC address
Config.Description: TV's MAC address, used to wake it from standby.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port the remote page is served on (host networking, so this is the port on your Unraid server).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the config files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the config files.
